iti75:2.1: Tayo-me bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
iti75:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo sabbesaññeva na dātā hoti, samaṇabrāhmaṇakapaṇiddhikavanibbakayācakānaṃ annaṃ pānam vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ,
iti75:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo avuṭṭhikasamo hoti. --
iti75:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ekaccānaṃ dātā hoti, ekaccānaṃ na dātā hoti, samaṇabrāhmaṇakapaṇiddhikavanibbakayācakānaṃ annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ,
iti75:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo padesavassī hoti. --
iti75:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo sabbesaṃ deti, samaṇabrāhmaṇakapaṇiddhikavanibbakayācakānaṃ annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ,
iti75:5.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo sabbatthābhivassī hoti. --
iti75:5.4: Ime kho bhikkhave tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin-ti. --
iti75:11.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||6|| 76. (Tik.
